review_timing: Recorded after Phase21 plan freeze and reservation, before interpreting any model outputs; no frozen file was modified.

source_reconciliation_check.finding: The frozen reconciliation script deterministically rematches every raw activity to one manually assembled primary-table structure, then checks units, relation, and numeric value. A temporary rerun reproduced 45 source rows, 41 exact rows, and the same four exclusions. No potency-only join is used.

primary_table_and_method_limits.identity_checks: The script's canonical graph joins and exact ChEMBL value checks passed; this verifies consistency between the transcription and raw export, but does not replace independent visual review of every drawn R-group in the article tables.

known_source_exclusions.12h: Table 4 reports 1 nM while narrative text reports <1 nM; excluded as conflicting exact/censored evidence

primary_table_and_method_limits.historical_method: The urea article/SI reports the Cisbio STK2 HTRF ROCK-I/II assay and ROCK-II 1-543 cloned/purified as described in the cited Schröter protocol. Calculated final ROCK-II conditions are approximately 10 uM ATP, 0.25 nM enzyme, and 0.5 uM substrate. These calculations are not direct final concentrations, and the 2013 ROCK-II lot/catalog identity is not supplied.
primary_table_and_method_limits.construct_transfer_limit: The frozen model uses human ROCK2 residues 11-552; the cited urea method identifies ROCK-II 1-543. This is a material assay-construct mismatch that must remain in conclusions.
primary_table_and_method_limits.article_version_limit: The archived article is an accepted/proof copy; source claims should retain that version qualification.

leakage_and_split_checks.finding: The frozen dataset and plan contain the same 41 IDs. The whole-group split is scaffold-disjoint, has 15 singleton test scaffolds, and satisfies the six-scaffold and 40% maximum-single-test-scaffold rules. No exact or achiral structure/ID overlap with Phase17, Phase18, or Phase20 was found in an independent recomputation.

scientific_cautions: The 26 calibration rows occupy only 3 scaffolds, so any scalar assay offset may be dominated by the principal urea series.
The 15 test scaffolds are all singletons; scaffold-level uncertainty is consequently weak, and Murcko groups are bookkeeping units rather than independent mechanisms.
Pendant-ring and side-chain changes can inflate Murcko scaffold counts while retaining a common binding pharmacophore; report chemical relatedness separately.
The assay is retrospective biochemical inhibition. It cannot establish prospective novelty, independence from model pretraining, cellular efficacy, CPA ice activity, or post-thaw survival.

launch_assessment.scientific_scope: Launch may proceed under the frozen plan, with the above method and diversity limitations carried into the output report.
launch_assessment.interpretation_rule: Any incomplete or invalid output is inconclusive under the frozen partial-output policy; do not select a successful subset or alter the split after seeing predictions.
